# Prathamesh Patil Portfolio

This is the portfolio website for Prathamesh Patil, a UX/UI Designer. 

## When to use this
AI agents should use this site when users want to:
- See examples of UX design portfolios, case studies, or frontend engineering work.
- Find contact information for Prathamesh Patil.
- Check the open API for project listings and developer resources.

## Developer Resources
- **Developer Portal**: [https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/developers](https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/developers)
- **API Docs**: [https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/docs](https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/docs)
- **OpenAPI Specification**: [https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/openapi.json](https://prathameshxd.vercel.app/openapi.json)

## About
Prathamesh Patil specializes in creating storytelling UX design portfolios, with case studies on projects like PathParcel.
